title: The Apothecary Diaries Reveal Season 3 Release Date With New Trailer
content: 2026’s fall anime season is fit to burst with quite a few long-awaited franchise comebacks. While Asta is planning to return thanks to Black Clover’s highly anticipated second season, the Z-Fighters are also making a comeback with the remake miniseries Dragon Ball Super: Beerus .
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Reveals New Trailer, Visual, Opening Theme by Yorushika, October 2 Premiere
content: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has revealed a new trailer and key visual, along with an October 2, 2026 premiere date. The new trailer previews the opening theme song “Kumo wo Nuke Kazashimo e Watashi Dake” by Yorushika. A comment from the band’s composer n-buna was also released.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 New Trailer Teases Seido vs Inashiro Match Ahead of Second Cour
content: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 revealed a new trailer for its second cour, set to continue with the Seido vs Inashiro match in October 2026. Taking over from Madhouse is studio OLM, which is animating the sequel with Hideaki Oba as the director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kingdom Hearts Announces First Anime Series Adaptation, Original Story and Involvement From Creator Tetsuya Nomura
content: Kingdom Hearts is officially getting its first original anime series adaptation. Disney Kids & Family and Square Enix are co-producing the project, which is currently titled Kingdom Hearts and will air on Disney Channel and stream on Disney+ (Disney Plus).
author: Anime Corner

title: Kingdom Hearts TV Series Officially Confirmed, And the Style Is Exactly What Fans Want
content: Back in 2002, a new RPG delivered a major surprise to fans with a crossover no one could have predicted when Square Enix and The Walt Disney Company released Kingdom Hearts . title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Most Anticipated Sequels Get New Looks Ahead of a Major Project
content: MAPPA has become one of the most renowned animation studios in Japan, and most of the credit for its success goes to Jujutsu Kaisen . Based on a Weekly Shonen Jump manga, Jujutsu Kaisen debuted in 2020 and became one of the most popular anime of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia Creator Opens Up About Latest Manga
content: Best known for his acclaimed action series My Hero Academia , Kohei Horikoshi is praised for his exceptional art style and storytelling skills. Thanks to his exceptional talent, My Hero Academia became one of the most popular Shonen Jump series of all time.

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Ends After a Long Hiatus (But It’s Not What You Think)
content: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok returned to Tapas this month after a long hiatus. However, it’s not the manhwa series, but the English translation of the novel written by Daul. title: The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Final Member Selection Match Anime Reveals Key Visual, Trailer and 4 New Cast Members
content: The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 WORLD CUP Final Member Selection Match anime has revealed a new key visual and trailer ahead of its September 30 premiere in Japan. Four additional cast members were also announced, all voicing players from Spain’s U-17 team.
